keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Cardiff City 1, West Ham United 0. Jack Moylan (Cardiff City) right footed shot from outside the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Alex Robertson.
Maximilian Kilman (West Ham United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Soungoutou Magassa (West Ham United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Cardiff City 2, West Ham United 0. Jack Moylan (Cardiff City) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
Goal! Cardiff City 3, West Ham United 0. Jack Moylan (Cardiff City) header from the right side of the six yard box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Joel Bagan with a cross following a corner.
First Half ends, Cardiff City 3, West Ham United 0.
Substitution, West Ham United. Ezra Mayers replaces Morato.
Substitution, West Ham United. Mohamadou Kanté replaces Soungoutou Magassa.
Substitution, West Ham United. Joël Piroe replaces Valentín Castellanos.
Substitution, Cardiff City. Joel Colwill replaces Rubin Colwill.
Substitution, Cardiff City. Cian Ashford replaces Chris Willock.

Goal! Cardiff City 3, West Ham United 1. Divine Mukasa (West Ham United) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Jarrod Bowen with a through ball following a fast break.
Goal! Cardiff City 3, West Ham United 2. Arne Engels (West Ham United) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Joël Piroe with a through ball.
Delay in match because of an injury Perry Ng (Cardiff City).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, West Ham United. Edvin Austbø replaces Manor Solomon.
Substitution, Cardiff City. David Turnbull replaces Calum Scanlon.
Substitution, Cardiff City. Ronan Kpakio replaces Perry Ng because of an injury.
Delay in match because of an injury Maximilian Kilman (West Ham United).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Cardiff City 3, West Ham United 3. Maximilian Kilman (West Ham United) left footed shot from very close range to the top right corner. Assisted by Jarrod Bowen with a cross.
Joël Veltman (West Ham United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, West Ham United. Tomás Soucek replaces Joël Veltman.
Second Half ends, Cardiff City 3, West Ham United 3.
